test_polymorphic_cpp_return: test that a C++ created B object returns B::f() when calling method f through Python
test_type_references: test that unexposed C++ class B returns type A while exposed class C returns type C
test_factory_pattern: test the factory function returns correct types A or C based on the integer argument passed
test_python_subclass_override: test that a Python subclass X of A correctly overrides method f and call_f returns X.f
test_wrapper_downcast: test that passing a D instance through pass_a preserves the ability to call D::g
